title: Learning operators on labelled conditional distributions with applications to mean field control of non exchangeable systems
summary: We study the approximation of operators acting on probability measures on a product space with prescribed marginal. Let $I$ be a label space endowed with a reference measure $λ$, and define $\cal M_λ$ as the set of probability measures on $I\times \mathbb{R}^d$ with first marginal $λ$. By disintegration, elements of $\cal M_λ$ correspond to families of labeled conditional distributions.
